items.title: 68516_Gene Ramey oral history interview
items.q: There was some man down in Houston who actually was running all those tours. He was something -- Ash, or something like that. Ashby?

ctx.x:
And he leased this club called the Century Room.
They bought us some fine uniforms, black coats and -- what you that the men wear, call those striped pants, like evening dress, Gamble, waistells,4le striped trousers. And made a good appearance. And McShann did pretty good there.
But in the meantime, Johnny was booking those tours. There was some man down in Houston who actually was running all those tours. He was something -- Ash, or something like that. Ashby?
